title: Breaking Badlands
description: Makes deserts and badlands... extremely realistic...
body:
### April Fools 2026!

Minecraft's desert and badlands biomes are currently very unrealistic. As an avid consumer of TV and movies I have a very clear sense of what they should look like, and what they should look like is YELLOW! Fortunately, changes in 26.1 have allowed me to rectify this glaring inconsistency and return them to their natural state. All other biomes are unchanged so you can bask in that sweet, sweet visual transition whenever you set foot in an arid biome. _Vravo, Bince!_
